security.biometricsDescription: Use your fingerprint or face instead of typing the passcode.
security.description: A passcode in front of the app on this device. It stays on when you sign out, and applies whether or not you use an account.
security.lockedDescription: Enter your passcode to carry on.
security.mismatch: The two passcodes do not match.
security.noRecoveryWarning: There is no way to recover this passcode. Forgetting it means reinstalling the app and signing in again.
security.requirePasscodeDescription: Ask for it before the app opens.
security.title: Security

settings.accountLocalOnlyDescription: Your data stays on this device only. Sign in to back it up and sync across devices.

advanced.hidePausedStatusDescription: Queued changes still sync as soon as you are on Wi-Fi.
advanced.title: Advanced
advanced.wifiOnlyDescription: Changes keep saving on this device and go up the next time you're on Wi-Fi. The data is text, so this rarely saves much.

ai.apiKeyHint: Optional for a machine of your own. Stored on the server and never shown again.
ai.baseUrlHint: The base URL of a chat-completions API, without the /chat/completions path.
ai.description: The model that reads a shared post and suggests the places in it. Any OpenAI-compatible endpoint works: a machine at home, Groq, OpenRouter.
ai.signInRequired: Sign in to configure the model — it runs on the server, not on this device.
ai.title: Extraction model

deleteAccount.actionDescription: Erase everything and your account from the server. This cannot be undone, so export a backup first if there is anything you want to keep.
deleteAccount.bulletAccount: Your account is closed. Signing in with Google again would start from nothing.
deleteAccount.bulletContent: Every place, rating, note and saved post is deleted, along with your settings.
deleteAccount.bulletDevices: Your other devices keep whatever they have already downloaded until you sign out on them.
deleteAccount.description: This erases everything from the server and closes your account. There is no way to undo it and no copy kept.
deleteAccount.exportFirstDescription: Saves everything to a JSON file you can import again later. Strongly recommended.
deleteAccount.lockDescription: Confirm it is you before everything is erased.
deleteAccount.needsConnection: Needs a connection to the server. Try again once you are back online.
deleteAccount.resumedDescription: Signed in again. This is the last step, and it cannot be undone.
deleteAccount.signInDescription: Sign in with Google again to confirm it is you.
deleteAccount.signInFailed: Couldn't confirm it was you. Nothing was deleted.
deleteAccount.signInWhy: Your last sign-in is too old for something this final. Nothing has been deleted.
deleteAccount.title: Delete everything?

data.description: Your places, ratings and notes, as a file you keep.
data.exportOmits: Ratings and notes come first in the file. The model key never leaves the server, and device preferences are not included.
data.telemetryDescription: Anonymous errors and usage counts, so problems on this device can be found and fixed. Never a place name, a note or a link.
data.title: Data

general.hapticsDescription: A light tick when you press something.
general.languageDownloadFailed: Couldn't download that language. Try again when you're connected.
general.languageOfflineHint: Languages you haven't used on this device yet need a connection the first time.
general.quietNotificationsDescription: Stop confirming everyday actions like saving a place. Errors, and confirmations for settings and backups, still appear.
general.title: General

settings.signOutPendingTitle_other: Sign out with {{count}} changes not yet saved to your account?
settings.title: Settings
